description: Prospective zero-readback finite-set memory midpoint minimax action under unknown execution; never claim exact or safety when clipping
observation: policy state projection strips target_pose channel; no hidden target readback for robust midpoint decisions; controller may disclose target for oracle and exactly one readback comparator
minimax_method: After unknown ACK preserve both possible commanded-target poses; compute arithmetic midpoint of their translational components and SO(3) geodesic midpoint of rotations; convert desired achieved-relative source goal to a bounded destination action relative to midpoint. Propagate all hypotheses with the *same actually dispatched command* after fault; no private state or postfault target observation used to prune hypotheses. Mark all projected actions NON_EXACT. SO3 midpoint minimizes max geodesic distance between two rotations, but clipped action limits, controller dynamics and task rewards invalidate any general globally optimal recovery claim.
required_logs: two belief hypothesis target-separation after fault
actual target vs hypothesis (audit only at end)
claim_limit: Known additive root-frame Panda EE target controller only. This is simulated native target-hold rather than network packet loss. No hardware, learned VLA, independent scientific replication or proven cross-robot transport. Directly compare equal-zero-readback optimistic and pessimistic arms, and unequal-information one-readback/oracle. Preserve negative result.
